data.name: Psionic Spear
data.description: You can apply the benefits of Psionic Shot to melee attacks made with a spear, longspear, or shortspear.  Should you gain the Greater Psionic Shot or Fell Shot feats, they also apply to melee attacks made with a spear, longspear, or shortspear.
